coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Matches 4 of 7 required variable items at the core semantic level (57%): torsion sine/cosine features reduced with TICA, model-generated versus reference MD trajectories, backbone torsion JSD, and sidechain torsion JSD. Optional sampling-speed assessment is excluded from scoring.
coverage.design_error_analysis: Does not preserve the fixed explicit-solvent 100 ns simulation setup, instead allowing implicit solvent and proposing microsecond-scale sampling. Omits first-frame-conditioned generation of 10 ns segments concatenated into 100 ns trajectories. Does not specify JSD over TICA-0, using TICA free-energy and state-overlap metrics instead. Also omits MDGEN identification, PyEMMA, and the required 100-bin torsion discretization; sine/cosine features are offered alongside an alternative distance representation.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion output is empty, so it does not semantically match the expected conclusion.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: Missing the expected near-replicate torsion JSD values of approximately 0.1 or lower, reasonable TICA-0 agreement, and capture of fast and slow relaxation dynamics and reference metastable regions.
